wins.text: Worldwide Q1 sales of $24.1B, operational growth of 6.4% despite ~540 bps STELARA headwind; excluding STELARA, company grew double digits
DARZALEX sales reached $4B with 17.8% operational growth, driven by 5.9 points of share gains across all lines of therapy and nearly 12 points in frontline
TREMFYA delivered 63.8% growth, now the share leader in new patient starts in IBD and fastest-growing IL-23 therapy in the U.S.
CARVYKTI achieved ~$600M in sales with 57.4% growth; TALVEY grew 72.8%; SPRAVATO grew 44.5% — multiple oncology/neuroscience brands delivering high double-digit growth

Full year 2026 operational sales guidance raised to 5.9%–6.9% with midpoint of $100.2B; adjusted EPS guidance raised by $0.02 to $11.30–$11.50 range; 64th consecutive year of dividend growth announced at 3.1% increase to $5.36/share

risks.text: STELARA declined 61.7% due to biosimilar competition, creating an ~920 bps headwind to Innovative Medicine and ~540 bps headwind to total company growth

Adjusted pretax operating margin compressed from 36.6% to 32.5%; Innovative Medicine margin fell from 42.5% to 39.7% and MedTech margin fell from 25.9% to 22.3%, driven by tariff impacts, heavier launch investment and unfavorable mix
Tariff impact on MedTech cost of goods sold cited as a driver of margin deleverage; broader tariff environment flagged as an ongoing headwind
Volume-based procurement (VBP) in China expected to create second-half headwind for electrophysiology products, already factored into full-year guidance
U.S. Surgical Vision declined in Q1 due to new competitive entrants; Surgery segment grew only 1.2% with competitive pressures in energy and endocutters and VBP in China across the portfolio

guidance_items.detail: Operational sales guidance raised to 5.9%–6.9% growth with midpoint of $100.2B (6.4%); reported sales growth guided to 6.5%–7.5% with midpoint of $100.8B (7%), reflecting flat euro spot rate vs. prior quarter
Adjusted operational EPS raised by $0.02 to $11.30–$11.50 range (5.7% growth at midpoint); reported adjusted EPS midpoint of $11.55 (7.1% growth)
Adjusted pretax operating margin guidance maintained at improvement of at least 50 bps for full year 2026, with heavier investment front-loaded in H1
Full-year free cash flow outlook maintained at approximately $21B; net interest expense, net other income, and effective tax rate guidance all unchanged

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Abiomed/Impella competitive and clinical risk — post-ACC data suggesting potential 30% reduction in high-risk population use, and increasing IVL competitive dynamics for Shockwave
U.S. Surgical Vision decline in Q1 due to new competitive entrants — management did not proactively address the U.S.-specific softness
ICONIC-ASCEND head-to-head trial readout vs. TYK2 inhibitor and its importance to ICOTYDE payer/commercial negotiations — not mentioned in prepared remarks
